DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのことですね。最後に見た場所を、分かる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing. Please tell me where you last saw it, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 催しの入口にあった臨時の駐輪場所です。今朝戻ったら、置いた辺りの柵の位置が変わっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 催し入口の臨時駐輪場所に停め、今朝は周辺の柵の位置が変わっていたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At the temporary bicycle parking near the event entrance. When I returned this morning, the fencing around where I parked had been moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain parking at the event entrance's temporary area and finding the nearby fences repositioned this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駐輪場所が変わった可能性も含めて伺います。停めたときの時刻と、自転車の特徴は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will consider the possibility that the parking area changed too. Do you know when you parked and the bicycle's features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方六時ごろです。車体は紺色で、前かごの左側に白い傷があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夕方六時ごろ停めたこと、紺色の車体と前かご左の白い傷を伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around six yesterday evening. The frame is navy, with a white scratch on the left of the front basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State yesterday around six p.m., the navy frame and white scratch on the front basket's left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その特徴を記録します。登録番号の書類や、車体全体が分かる写真はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record that. Do you have registration documents or a photograph showing the whole bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 登録の書類は家ですが、買ったときの写真なら電話にあります。番号は推測せず、帰ってから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録書類は家だが購入時写真はあると答え、登録番号は推測せず後で確認すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Registration papers are at home, but purchase-day photos are on my phone. I will not guess the number; I will check after returning home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say registration documents are home but you have purchase photos, and will check the number later without guessing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真は確認の参考になります。鍵の状態と、今朝探した範囲も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Photos can help verification. Tell me the lock condition and how far you searched this morning too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後輪の鍵をかけました。元の場所の周りは見ましたが、主催者の案内所にはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 後輪を施錠し元の場所周辺は探したが主催者案内所への照会はまだだと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I locked the rear wheel. I looked around the original spot, but have not asked the organizer's information office yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain locking the rear wheel and searching near the original spot, but not yet asking the organizer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も含めて相談を伺います。元の位置をこの会場図で示せますか。主催者へ確認できた内容も、後でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will include that in the consultation. Can you show the original position on this venue map? Tell us later what the organizer confirms too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口から二列目のこの場所です。案内所で移動の有無を尋ね、登録書類を見つけたら追加で連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会場図で入口から二列目を示し、移動の有無と登録書類を確認後に追加連絡すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: This spot in the second row from the entrance. I will ask the office whether it was moved, and contact you with more information when I find the registration papers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the second row from the entrance and say you will check movement and registration documents before providing additional information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所と特徴を記録しました。確認できた情報を追加していただければ、相談内容に追記します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We recorded the place and features. Any additional confirmed information will be added to your inquiry. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒をお送りになる前に、必要な記録や届く時期のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before sending the envelope, do you need any particular record or delivery timing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出先の案内に「送付した記録を残してください」とあります。追跡で見られることと、受け取った記録は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出先の送付記録の指示を伝え、追跡と受取りの記録は同じか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient's instructions say to keep a record of sending. Is being able to track it the same as a record of receiving it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the recipient's sending-record instruction and ask whether tracking and receipt records are the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ意味とは限らないので、提出先の条件を確かめたいですね。その一文の前後も見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: They do not necessarily mean the same thing, so we should check the recipient's requirements. Can you show the text before and after that sentence too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この次に「受付の控えは手元に保管」と書かれています。受取人の署名が必要とは書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付控え保管の続きの文を示し、受取人署名の指定は書かれていないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Next it says to keep the acceptance receipt yourself. It does not say a recipient signature is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the following sentence requiring the acceptance receipt to be kept, and explain there is no signature requirement written. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、控えに残る内容と追跡の有無を比較表で見ましょう。先方へいつまでに届けたいというご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us compare what the receipt records and whether tracking is available. By when would you like it to reach them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金曜までに届いてほしいのですが、見込みと条件を聞いてから送り方を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金曜到着を希望し、見込みと条件を聞いてから送付方法を選びたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: By Friday, ideally, but I want to hear estimates and conditions before deciding the method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want Friday delivery and will choose the method after hearing estimates and conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確約できるかは取扱い条件によります。こちらの方法は控えと追跡について案内がありますが、提出先が求める記録と合うかもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: A guarantee depends on handling conditions. This method has receipt and tracking guidance, but check whether it matches the record the recipient requires too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この控えで提出先の条件を満たすか、先方へ確認してから決めます。今日はまだ封をせず、書類の控えも取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えが提出先の条件を満たすか先方へ確認してから選び、未封のまま書類の控えも作ると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask them whether this receipt satisfies their requirements before deciding. I will leave it unsealed today and copy the documents too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to confirm receipt acceptance with the recipient before choosing, and keep it unsealed while making document copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、方法を決めてからお持ちください。宛名には部署名がありますが、担当者のお名前も記載する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then bring it once you decide the method. The address has a department; will you also add a staff member's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内には部署名だけなので、勝手に人の名前は足しません。送付方法と宛先を確認してから封筒を持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部署名だけの案内へ人名を推測で足さず、送付方法と宛先確認後に持参すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: The instructions name only the department, so I will not invent a person's name. I will bring the envelope after confirming method and destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not guess and add a person's name to department-only instructions; say you will bring it after confirming method and destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 比較の案内をお渡しします。確認後に、封筒と一緒にお持ちください。お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the comparison guide. Bring it with the envelope after confirming. We look forward to seeing you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与受取り用の口座のご相談ですね。勤務先から指定された内容はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about an account for receiving salary. Do you have your workplace's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この案内です。口座名義をカタカナで書く欄が短く、長い名前をどこまで書くのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先の名義記入欄が短く、長いカタカナ名をどこまで書くか迷っていると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: These. The katakana account-name field is short, so I am unsure how much of my long name to write.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the workplace's name field is short and you are unsure how much of a long katakana name to enter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 銀行への申込み名義と、勤務先の入力欄は分けて確認しましょう。ご本人の名前を確認できる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the bank application name separately from the workplace's input field. Do you have identification showing your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードがあります。会社では呼びやすい短い名前を使いますが、申込書をその名前で書くのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 在留カードを提示し、会社での短い呼び名を申込名義に使うのは避けたいと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My residence card. I use a short, easy-to-say name at work, but want to avoid using that name on the application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your residence card and explain you want to avoid applying with the short name used at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書類のお名前を基に担当者と確認します。勤務先の情報が分かる物も持参されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check with staff using the name on your document. Have you also brought something showing your workplace information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 社員証はありますが、入社日の書類は家に置いてきました。今日必要か、担当の方に確かめてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 社員証は持参し入社日の書類は家だと伝え、今日必要か担当への確認を頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my employee card, but left the employment-start-date document at home. Please ask the staff whether it is needed today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have your employee card, the start-date document is home, and ask staff to confirm whether it is needed today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な確認項目を整理します。書類を持参しても、審査や追加確認で日を改める場合があり、今日の開設はお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will organize the necessary checks. Even with documents, screening or additional checks may mean another day, so opening today cannot be promised.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口座情報の提出期限が近いのですが、すぐ番号を伝えられるとは限らないので、会社にも事情を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口座情報の提出期限が近いがすぐ番号を伝えられるとは限らないため、会社へ事情を説明すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The account-information deadline is close, but I may not be able to give a number immediately, so I will explain the situation to work too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the submission deadline is near but a number may not be available immediately, so you will explain to work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがよいと思います。勤務先の名義欄については、何を確認するかメモしておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That sounds sensible. Would you like to note what to ask work about their name field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 正式な名義を省略せず入力できるか、会社へ聞きます。こちらでは不足書類と次の申込方法を紙で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式名義を省略せず入力できるか会社へ確認し、不足書類と次の申込方法の書面案内を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask whether the formal name can be entered without abbreviation. Here, please give me written guidance on missing documents and the next application steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask work about entering the full formal name, and request written guidance on missing documents and the next application method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認事項をこの用紙にまとめて、申込担当へおつなぎします。まだ開設結果ではない点も含めてご覧ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will summarize the checks on this sheet and connect you to application staff. Read it knowing this is not yet an opening result. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その棚は本体ボトルと詰替えが隣り合っています。値札をお確かめでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: The bottle and refill are next to each other on that shelf. Are you checking the price tags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ボトルの下に安い札がありますが、商品名の後ろに「詰替え」と読めます。これはボトルの値段ではないですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ボトル下の安い札に詰替えと書かれていることを指摘し、本体価格か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is a cheap tag below the bottle, but I can read refill after the product name. Is this not the bottle price?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out refill on the cheap tag under the bottle and ask whether it is the main bottle price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの札は詰替え用です。本体は隣の札で、容量も違います。ご自宅に使えるボトルはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This tag is for the refill. The bottle has the neighboring tag and a different capacity. Do you have a usable bottle at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ容器を持っていないので、本体が必要です。大きい方ではなく、小さい本体の札を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家に容器がないため本体が必要と伝え、小さい本体の値札を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not have a container yet, so need the main bottle. Show me the smaller bottle's tag, not the larger one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you need the main bottle because there is no container at home, and ask for the small bottle's price tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小さい本体はこの札です。上段が会員価格、下段が通常価格になっています。会員でいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the small bottle's tag. The upper line is member price, lower line regular price. Are you a member?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会員ではありません。安い方だけ見ていたので、今日は下段の通常価格で比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 非会員と答え、上段の安い表示ではなく下段の通常価格で比較したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I had only looked at the cheaper one, so today I want to compare the regular prices on the lower line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are not a member and want to compare lower regular prices rather than the cheaper upper display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。通常価格の表示はこちらです。同じ名前でも香りが違う物があるので、どちらをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Here is the regular price. The same name comes in different scents; which are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 無香料の方です。似た色の別の香りを取らないように、商品名と容量を札と照合してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 無香料を希望し、別の香りと間違えないよう商品名と容量を札と照合してほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Unscented. Can you match product name and capacity with the tag so I do not take another scent with a similar color?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request unscented and ask to match name and capacity to avoid a different scent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さい本体の無香料で、札の容量と一致しています。こちら一つでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the small unscented bottle, and capacity matches the tag. Is one enough?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この本体を一つ買います。詰替えは今回は選ばず、会計画面も通常価格の表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本体一つのみ購入し、詰替えは選ばず会計で通常価格も確認すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will buy one of these bottles. No refill this time, and I will also check the regular-price display at checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will buy one main bottle, not a refill, and check the regular price at payment too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの商品をレジへお持ちください。表示と違いがあれば、会計の際に店員へお知らせください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take this product to the till. If the display differs, tell staff during checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内を一周する道と、花壇までの往復が案内図にあります。今日はどのくらい歩く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The map has a park circuit and a return walk to the flower beds. How long do you plan to walk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長くても二十分くらいにしたいです。帰りの迎えがこの入口なので、別の出口へ出ない道を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最長二十分程度で、迎えが来る同じ入口へ戻る道を探していると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: At most about twenty minutes. My lift is at this entrance, so I want a route that does not exit somewhere else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say at most twenty minutes and a route returning to the same entrance for pickup. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池側の一周路には工事で通れない区間があります。花壇への往復なら同じ入口へ戻れますが、途中で休む予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pond-side circuit has a construction closure. The flower-bed return reaches the same entrance; are you planning a rest along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で一度座りたいです。池を回る道ではなく、花壇の方のベンチがある道にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一度座りたいと伝え、池一周でなく花壇側のベンチがある経路を選ぶ。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to sit once. I will choose the flower-bed route with a bench rather than the pond circuit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want one seated rest and choose the flower-bed bench route instead of the pond circuit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 花壇の手前に木陰のベンチがあります。図の点線は階段のある近道ですが、そちらも使うおつもりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a shaded bench before the flowers. The dotted line is a shortcut with stairs; do you intend to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 階段の近道は使いません。少し遠回りでも、来た道を引き返す方が分かりやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段の近道を使わず、遠回りでも来た道を戻ると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No stair shortcut. Even a slight detour is clearer if I return along the same path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to use the stair shortcut and return the way you came even if longer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、往復する線を印します。入口が似ているので、お迎えの方に伝える目印は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will mark the return line. The entrances look similar; have you chosen a landmark to tell the person collecting you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この案内所の横にある丸い時計を目印にします。迎えの人にも、その時計の所で待つと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内所横の丸い時計を目印にし、迎えの人へ待合せ位置を知らせると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The round clock beside this information office. I will tell them I will wait at that clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the round clock by the office and tell your lift the meeting position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時計はこちらの位置です。ベンチで休む時間も見ながら、戻る時刻はご自身で調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The clock is here. Adjust your return time yourself, allowing for the time resting on the bench too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歩く時間だけで二十分使わず、休む分も残して戻ります。閉鎖の表示がある所には進みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二十分の中に休憩も含めて戻ると伝え、閉鎖表示のある区間へは進まないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not use the whole twenty minutes just walking; I will leave room for rest and return. I will not enter sections marked closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say rest is included within twenty minutes and that you will not enter closed sections. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、印を付けた図をお持ちください。道が分からなくなったら案内所へお声がけください。よいお散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then take the marked map. If you lose your way, ask at the office. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その経路検索で、どの部分をご確認なさりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of that route search would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の家に行くのですが、メッセージは「広場前」、検索結果は「広場入口」になっていて、同じ停留所か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人のメッセージと検索結果で広場前と広場入口の名称が異なり、同じ停留所か分からないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to a friend's home. Their message says Hiroba-mae, but the search says Hiroba-iriguchi, and I do not know if it is the same stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the friend's Hiroba-mae and search's Hiroba-iriguchi differ and you cannot tell whether they are the same stop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの一覧では別の停留所です。お友達と待ち合わせる場所も書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are different stops in this list. Is the meeting place written too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待ち合わせは広場前の屋根のある待合所です。「入口」のほうで降りるつもりで調べてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待ち合わせが広場前の屋根のある待合所だと答え、広場入口で降りるつもりで検索した誤りを説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The covered waiting shelter at Hiroba-mae. I mistakenly searched intending to get off at the entrance stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer the meeting is the covered shelter at Hiroba-mae and explain the erroneous Hiroba-iriguchi search. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、到着する停留所を直して見直しましょう。この候補は途中で乗り換えますが、乗り換え時間もご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then correct the arrival stop and review. This option has a transfer; did you check transfer time too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗り換えが三分しかなく、荷物もあるので間に合うか心配です。一本後に乗り継ぐ候補も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗り換えが三分で荷物もあり不安だと伝え、一本後に乗り継ぐ候補を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only three minutes, and I have luggage, so I am worried. I also want an option connecting to the next service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say three minutes and luggage worry you, and ask about the following connection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 後の便にした場合の予定到着時刻を、この結果で比べられます。お友達には遅い到着でもよいか確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare planned arrival for the later service in these results. Can you ask your friend whether later arrival is acceptable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今連絡して、遅い候補の到着時刻でも待てると言ってもらいました。乗り換えに余裕を取るほうを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人に遅い候補の到着でよいと確認できたと報告し、乗り換えの余裕を優先する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I contacted them just now and they can wait for the later option's arrival. I will prioritize transfer time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report your friend accepts the later arrival and prioritize a comfortable transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発便と乗り換え先の行き先を分けて控えてください。遅れによって接続が変わる場合は、その場でも確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Note the initial service and transfer destination separately. If delays change the connection, confirm there too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの便を別々にメモします。降りるのは「広場前」で、「広場入口」ではないことも書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二便を分けて控え、降車先は広場入口ではなく広場前だとメモに明記すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note both services separately, and explicitly write that I get off at Hiroba-mae, not Hiroba-iriguchi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note the two services separately and specify Hiroba-mae, not Hiroba-iriguchi. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その区別でご確認ください。乗る前にも行き先表示をお確かめになって、お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, keep that distinction. Check the destination display before boarding too, and travel safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請でしょうか。それとも、必要な種類のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying for a certificate, or asking which type is needed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先の住宅の手続きで、住所の載った証明を持ってくるよう言われました。何を申し込むのか、まだ決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先の住宅手続きで住所の証明を求められたが、申し込む種類が決まらないと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: For workplace housing, I was told to bring proof with my address. I cannot yet decide which to apply for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an undecided certificate type for workplace housing address proof. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先の案内があれば拝見します。証明書の正式な名称や、誰の情報が必要かは書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can look at workplace instructions if you have them. Do they give the official name or whose information is needed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメモには「家族の分も確認」とあります。ただ、全員分の証明が要るという意味か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の分も確認というメモを示し、全員分の証明が必要という意味か分からないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This note says check family too. I do not know whether it means certificates for everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show check family too and say you do not know whether everyone's certificates are required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先が必要とする範囲は、こちらでは決められません。勤務先へ尋ねられる連絡先はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot decide the scope the recipient needs. Is there a workplace contact you can ask?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当に送った質問への返信が今来ました。証明は私本人の分でよく、家族については別の用紙に書くそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先から本人分の証明でよく家族情報は別用紙という返信が来たと報告する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: A reply to my question has just arrived. The certificate only needs me, and family details go on another form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the workplace reply says your own certificate only, with family information on a separate sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 証明は本人分だけと分かったのですね。住所以外の記載事項についても、指定があるか確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: So only your certificate. Have you confirmed whether entries besides address are specified too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そこまでは聞けていません。世帯主や続柄も載せるのか、追加で尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所以外は未確認と答え、世帯主や続柄を載せる必要があるか追加で尋ねたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not that far. I want to ask additionally whether household head and relationship are needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say non-address entries are unconfirmed and you want to ask about household head and relationship. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要事項がそろってから申請するほうが、取り直しを避けやすいですね。質問を書き留める用紙をお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Applying after all requirements are known helps avoid getting it again. Would you like paper to note your questions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その用紙を使います。本人分であることと、世帯主・続柄が必要かを整理してから勤務先へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙を希望し、本人分という条件と世帯主・続柄の要否を整理して勤務先へ連絡すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use it. I will organize that it concerns me and whether household head and relationship are needed, then contact work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request paper and say you will organize your own-certificate condition and household-head/relationship questions before contacting work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの用紙をお渡しします。提出先の回答をお持ちになったら、交付の手続きと必要書類のご案内を続けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the sheet. Once you bring the recipient's answer, let us continue with issuance procedures and necessary documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票をお持ちですね。意味の分かりにくい欄を一緒に見ましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have the medical questionnaire. Shall we look together at a field whose meaning is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「随伴症状」という言葉は読めますが、意味が分かりません。耳が詰まる感じについて、どこまで書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 随伴症状の意味が分からないと伝え、耳の詰まり感について何を書く欄か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can read accompanying symptoms but do not know its meaning. What should I write about the clogged feeling in my ear?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say accompanying symptoms is unclear and ask what to write about ear blockage in that field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今お困りの症状に加えて、同じころにほかの症状があるかを伺う欄です。耳の感じは、いつからでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It asks whether there are other symptoms around the same time in addition to the main problem. When did the ear feeling start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方からです。痛いというより詰まった感じなので、「耳が痛い」とは書きたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夕方からの詰まり感であり痛みとは違うため、耳が痛いとは書きたくないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday evening. It feels clogged rather than painful, so I do not want to write ear pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain blockage since yesterday evening differs from pain, so you do not want to write ear pain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身が感じている言葉でお書きください。ほかに気づいている症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Use your own words for what you feel. Any other symptoms you have noticed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時々音が響くように感じます。耳鳴りと同じかは分からないので、そのままの言葉で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時々音が響く感じがあり、耳鳴りか分からないので自分の表現で伝えたいと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sometimes sound seems to resonate. I do not know whether that is tinnitus, so want to describe it as it feels.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say sound sometimes resonates, you do not know whether it is tinnitus and want your own description. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 呼び名を無理に決めず、その感じを診察でお伝えください。症状が続いているか、ときどきなのかも分けていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not force a name; describe the feeling during examination. You can also distinguish constant symptoms from occasional ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 詰まる感じは昨日から続いていて、音が響く感じは時々です。二つに分けて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 詰まりは昨日から続き音の響きは時々だと区別し、二つに分けて記入する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The blockage has continued since yesterday, but resonance is occasional. I will write them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish continuous blockage since yesterday from occasional resonance and enter separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その違いが分かるようにしましょう。説明を聞いて、まだ確認したい言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Make that difference clear. After the explanation, any other terms to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「随伴」は一緒に出ているほかの症状という意味ですね。響く音の原因は、診察で尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 随伴は一緒に出るほかの症状という意味だと確認し、音の原因は診察で尋ねたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Accompanying means other symptoms occurring together, right? I want to ask the doctor the cause of the resonating sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm accompanying symptoms means other simultaneous symptoms, and say you will ask the cause during examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、欄の意味はその理解で結構です。原因の判断は診察で確認しましょう。書き終えたら、こちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, that understanding of the field is fine. The examination should establish the cause. Hand it here once finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような連絡を受けたのか、お話しできる範囲で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what contact you received, as much as you feel able.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 未払いがあるという電話を受けました。知らないサービス名でしたが、最初に自分の氏名を答えてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らないサービスの未払いを主張する電話を受け、氏名を答えてしまったと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a call claiming unpaid fees. It was an unfamiliar service name, but I gave my full name at first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a call alleging unpaid charges for an unknown service and having given your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前以外に伝えた情報や、送金などの操作はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Besides your name, did you give other information or make any payment operations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所や口座番号は話していません。支払いの操作もせず、電話を切ってから相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所や口座番号は伝えず、支払操作もせず通話を切って来たと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No address or account number. I made no payment operation, hung up and came for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say no address or account number was given, no payment operated and you hung up before coming. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現時点で相手が近くに来ている、あるいは来ると言っている状況でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is the person nearby now, or saying they will come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来るとは言われていません。ただ、知らない番号から着信が続いていて、掛け直すべきか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手が来るとは言っていないが知らない番号から着信が続き、掛け直すか迷っていると説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They did not say they would come. But calls keep arriving from unfamiliar numbers, and I am unsure about calling back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain no threat to come, but continuing unknown calls and uncertainty about returning them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不安なまま相手の指示に従わず、まず内容を整理しましょう。着信履歴や通話について残しているものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not follow instructions while anxious; organize the content first. Do you have call history or anything kept about the conversation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 録音はありませんが、履歴は残っています。払うよう言われた内容を覚えているうちに書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録音はなく着信履歴は残ると答え、要求内容を覚えているうちに書いてよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No recording, but history remains. May I write what they demanded while I still remember?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there is no recording but call history remains, and ask to write demands while remembered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 覚えている言葉と、正確には思い出せない部分を分けて伺います。相手が名乗った名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will distinguish remembered words from parts you cannot recall exactly. Do you know the name they gave?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前は聞き取れませんでした。会社名らしい言葉だけメモにありますが、本当の会社かは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手の個人名は不明で会社名らしいメモだけがあり、その真偽は分からないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I could not catch the person's name. I only noted something sounding like a company name, but do not know whether it is real.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the personal name is unknown, only a company-like note remains, and its truth is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 名乗りが正しいかは未確認として記録します。着信履歴とメモを見ながら、相談を続ける担当へおつなぎします。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record the stated identity as unconfirmed. With the call history and note, I will connect you to staff continuing the consultation. Wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送前のご相談ですか。箱にはどのような物を入れてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this advice before dispatch? What is in the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内の家族あてで、本と湯のみ二個が入っています。持ち上げると中で動く音がするのが気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国内の家族へ本と湯のみ二個を送りたく、箱の中で物が動く音がすると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Books and two teacups for family in Japan. I am worried because I hear things moving when lifting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send books and two teacups to domestic family and hear movement inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 割れやすい物が入っているのですね。湯のみは、それぞれ何かで包んでありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are fragile items. Are the teacups individually wrapped in anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二個を一枚の紙で一緒に包み、本の上に置きました。箱を閉じる前に梱包を見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二個を一枚の紙で一緒に包み本の上に置いたと答え、封をする前に梱包を見直したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrapped both together in one sheet and put them on the books. I want to review packaging before sealing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say both were wrapped together in one sheet on the books, and you want to review before sealing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、まだ発送の受付には進めず、内容と状態を拝見しましょう。送り方についてのご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us inspect contents and condition without proceeding to shipping acceptance yet. Any wishes about the shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 発送後に追跡できる方法を希望します。ただ、表示を付ければ割れないと保証されるわけではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡できる方法を希望し、表示を付けるだけで破損しない保証にはならないか確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want tracking after dispatch. But a label alone does not guarantee it will not break, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request tracking and confirm a label alone does not guarantee no damage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示だけで破損がなくなる保証はできません。利用できる方法と取扱条件は、梱包した状態を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: A label alone cannot guarantee no breakage. We will advise available methods and conditions after checking the packed condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は家に持ち帰って包み直します。詰め直すと箱の大きさも変わるかもしれませんが、料金も確認し直す必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で包み直すと伝え、箱の大きさが変わる可能性があり、料金の再確認も必要か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take it home and rewrap today. The box size might change; do we need to check the price again too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will rewrap at home, box size may change and ask about rechecking the fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 大きさや重さは料金の確認に関わります。最終的な箱で測ってから比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Size and weight affect the fee. Measure the final box before comparing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それでは、料金と送り方は包み直した箱で決めます。追跡の希望も、次に来たときにもう一度伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最終の箱で料金と送り方を決め、再訪時にも追跡の希望を伝えると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will choose cost and method using the repacked box. I will state my tracking request again next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide cost and method on the final box and repeat tracking wishes at the next visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回は相談のみとして、箱をお返しします。梱包を見直された後でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. This is consultation only, and here is your box back. Bring it after reviewing packaging.
